work: The Book of the General Laws of the Inhabitants of the Jurisdiction of New-Plimo
heading: CAPITAL LAWS CHAP. II.

items.text: Do not curse or strike your natural father or mother.
items.citation: General Laws of New Plimouth, Capital Laws 13
items.quote: shall Curse or Smite their Natural Father or Mother

items.text: Obey the voice of your father and your mother, and receive their chastisement.
items.citation: General Laws of New Plimouth, Capital Laws 14
items.quote: shall not obey the voice of his Father, or the voice of his Mother

items.text: Give your children a Christian education and do not provoke them by extreme and cruel correction.
items.citation: General Laws of New Plimouth, Capital Laws 13
items.quote: the Parents have been very Unchristianly negligent in the Education of such Children

work: The Book of the General Laws of the Inhabitants of the Jurisdiction of New-Plimo
heading: CHAP. VIII. Minister〈…〉 Maintenance.

work: The Book of the General Laws of the Inhabitants of the Jurisdiction of New-Plimo
heading: CHAP. IX. Town-Affaires.

items.text: Maintain your covenant servant if he falls sick or lame, at your own charge, for the length of his indenture.
items.citation: Plymouth General Laws, CHAP. IX. Town-Affaires 3
items.quote: if his Servant fall sick or lame, he shall be maintained by his Masters particular charge, during the date of his Indentures or Covenant

items.text: Provide competently for your children and set them to work to earn a livelihood; if you do not, the town may place them in another family.
items.citation: Plymouth General Laws, CHAP. IX. Town-Affaires 4
items.quote: if there be any other Family that cannot or doth not provide competently for their Children, whereby they are exposed to want and extremity, It shall be in the power of the Select men of each Town, to place out such Children

work: The Book of the General Laws of the Inhabitants of the Jurisdiction of New-Plimo
heading: CHAP. VIII. Minister〈…〉 Maintenance. · Education of Children. … Mispending of Time.

items.text: Teach your children to read the Scriptures and to understand the main grounds of the Christian religion.
items.citation: Plymouth Laws, CHAP. VIII, Education of Children
items.quote: teach their Children... to read the Scriptures... and... the main Grounds and Principles of Christian Religion

items.text: Bring up your children in an honest and lawful calling, that they may be profitable to themselves and the country.
items.citation: Plymouth Laws, CHAP. VIII, Education of Children
items.quote: breed and bring up their Children... in some honest lawful calling, labour or imployment

items.text: Teach your servants to read the Scriptures and the main grounds of the Christian religion.
items.citation: Plymouth Laws, CHAP. VIII, Education of Children
items.quote: teach their Children and Servants... to read the Scriptures... and... the main Grounds and Principles of Christian Religion

items.text: Bring up your apprentices in an honest and lawful calling, that they may be profitable.
items.citation: Plymouth Laws, CHAP. VIII, Education of Children
items.quote: breed and bring up their... Apprentises in some honest lawful calling, labour or imployment

items.text: Live under your parents' government; do not cast it off.
items.citation: Plymouth Laws, CHAP. VIII, Mispending of Time
items.quote: will not be Governed by their Parents or Masters where they live

items.text: Live under your master's government; do not cast it off.
items.citation: Plymouth Laws, CHAP. VIII, Mispending of Time
items.quote: will not be Governed by their Parents or Masters where they live

work: The Book of the General Laws of the Inhabitants of the Jurisdiction of New-Plimo
heading: CHAP. X. Lands, Inheritances, and Wills. · WILLS.

items.text: When making your will, do not deprive your wife of a reasonable allowance for her subsistence.
items.quote: if any man do make an irrational and unrighteous will, whereby he deprives his Wife of her reasonable allowance for her subsistency

work: The Book of the General Laws of the Inhabitants of the Jurisdiction of New-Plimo
heading: CHAP. VIII. Minister〈…〉 Maintenance. · Marriages, Births and Burials, to be Registred.

items.text: Do not marry while under your parent's authority without his consent and approval.
items.quote: none shall be allowed to Marry that are under the Covert of Parents, Guardians, Masters, or Overseers, without their consent and approbation.

items.text: Do not inveigle or try to steal the affections of a man's daughter without his consent.
items.quote: Whosoever shall inveagle or endeavour to steal the Affections of any mans Daughter, Pupil or Maid-servant without his consent or leave

items.text: If a suitable marriage is proposed, do not refuse consent from selfish or covetous motives.
items.quote: if a meet Marriage be orderly proposed, and any Master or Guardian, out of any sinistre end, or covetous desire, will not upon reasonable tearms suffer it to be
no man shall strike his Wife
